findings.title: Candidate binding accepts an unapproved scanner contract version and prohibited scanner claims
findings.failure_condition: A manifest/file-set-bound scanner report has the expected report_type, PASS result and empty findings but carries a different or absent scan_contract_id/version, denies declared contract execution, or asserts prohibited global-clean/trusted-producer claims.
findings.reproducible_read_only_check: Generate a synthetic report with the current manifest/file-set/count, scan_contract_id=UNAPPROVED-SCANNER, scan_contract_version=999, and prohibited claims; pass it to generate-bootstrap-candidate and to the transient validateTask production fixture. Both accepted it, and all 20 existing production cases stayed green.
findings.observed: generate-bootstrap-candidate exited 0 and produced a bound BOOTSTRAP_WORKSPACE_CANDIDATE; validateTask kept PROD-01 structurally valid.
findings.expected: The scanner report must be rejected unless its exact contract ID/version and allowed/prohibited claims equal the approved v4 contract.
findings.impact: A bootstrap candidate can cryptographically bind a report that did not execute the approved scanner contract and that makes claims the contract expressly prohibits.
findings.required_resolution: Schema and validate the scanner report itself; require GOV-DETERMINISTIC-SCAN@4, INTERNAL_CONSISTENCY_ONLY, exact allowed claim booleans, exact manifest/file-set/count, PASS, and zero findings in both the candidate generator and validateTask. Add production and mutation negatives for ID, version, missing fields, and prohibited claims.

findings.title: The formal contract/binary oracle still does not enforce material policy equality or extension-magic safe-negatives
findings.failure_condition: The declared binary signature list, extension-magic policy, or entropy policy drifts, or EXTENSION_MAGIC_MISMATCH regresses to fire for every recognized signature regardless of extension.
findings.reproducible_read_only_check: Pass copies of the v4 contract with JPEG removed, extension_magic_mismatch changed to ignore, and entropy bounds changed to validateDeclaredScanContract; it returns no violations. In a transient copied module, replace the allowed-extension condition with an unconditional mismatch finding; all nine filed CASE-44..52 predicates remain green while matching-extension safe-negatives fail.
findings.observed: CASE-54's equality helper accepted material contract drift, and the complete filed binary-positive set survived the unsafe unconditional-mismatch mutation.
findings.expected: Contract, implementation, and fixture identities must be equal for all claimed material fields, and every extension-magic positive must have a formal matching-extension safe-negative protected by mutation testing.
findings.impact: The filed oracle can remain fully green while claimed binary/entropy policy changes silently or while the extension-magic classifier begins producing systematic false positives.
findings.required_resolution: Make the scanner contract the table-driven source for entropy, signature, and allowed-extension policy or compare every field exactly; add matching-extension safe-negatives for all nine signatures and mutations that remove, invert, and unconditionalize signature/mismatch logic.

a5_closure.reason: The exact A5 malformed-percent masking construction now preserves and detects the adjacent encoded Basic credential while also emitting MALFORMED_PERCENT_ENCODING; bounded and safe-negative cases passed independently.

Current recognizers work, but the formal regression boundary still accepts unapproved scanner report versions/claims, does not compare material contract fields, and lacks extension-magic matching-extension safe-negatives.

limitations: The review establishes only internal consistency of the exact workspace candidate and the declared scanner contract; it is not a Git trust anchor.
No OS sandbox, complete DLP, repository-global scan, or global sensitive-data absence was evaluated or claimed.
Unknown, encrypted, compressed, fragmented, split, and beyond-contract multiply encoded secrets remain outside the approved contract and are not blockers.
Product, service, database, seed, migration, and external evidence behavior was not inspected or executed.
An incidental first Node one-liner failed because the PowerShell native-command boundary stripped nested quotes; the same check was immediately rerun successfully with corrected quoting.
A nonessential Get-CimInstance process-inspection attempt was denied by Windows permissions; no review conclusion depends on it.
conclusion: The exact 81-file candidate and current scanner implementation are internally consistent, and A5-SEC-HIGH-001 is closed. A5-SEC-HIGH-002 is not closed: production candidate binding accepts scanner reports with an unapproved version and prohibited claims, while the formal contract/binary oracle does not enforce material policy equality or extension-magic safe-negatives. These are proven in-contract misses, so the A6 Security outcome is BLOCKER.
